# Mobile App EH — working rules

Bare React Native (0.86.x, TypeScript). **No Expo** in any form (no `expo-*` packages, no EAS, no prebuild).
**No hand-written native code** (no Swift/Obj-C/Kotlin): only files generated by the RN template exist under `ios/` and `android/`; everything native comes from libraries. If a library does not support RN 0.86 / New Architecture, pick another or ask.

iOS first; Android is scaffolded but not built or tested yet. Keep JS platform-agnostic: all native access goes through `src/platform/*` adapters.

## Migration plan
Plan: `C:\Users\raksh\.claude\plans\in-the-folder-mobile-twinkly-rose.md`.
- Phase 0: scaffold (done) · Phase 1: pages on fixtures (1A UI kit, 1B Dashboard + Closing this week, 1C Tenders, 1D Projects done; 1E Alerts/Bookmarks next, then 1F–1G) · Phase 2: logic (parts 2A–2H).
- Navigation: 4 bottom tabs (Dashboard, Tenders, Projects, More). Alerts is a bell at the top right of the Dashboard header and opens a pushed screen.
- Every new screen must render in both Solid and Glass (and dark). In the browser preview a control panel (left of the phone) flips style, mode, accent and base live.
- Layout rules: the tab bar is fixed to the bottom and never scrolls (content scrolls behind it and fades out); every `Screen` puts a scrim over the top safe area so scrolled content never runs under the clock/battery row. The browser preview frames a tall iPhone (430 x 932, insets 59/34) with a simulated status row.
- Browser preview on Windows: `npm run dev` (react-native-web + Vite in `web/`, preview only).
- Logic is ported from `../Mobile App RN/src/lib` (read-only reference).

## Conventions
- Styling: `StyleSheet` + `useTheme()` tokens from `src/theme` (accent, White/Paper base, Solid/Glass, dark). No hardcoded colours in screens.
- Fonts: `fonts.*` from `src/theme` (Plus Jakarta Sans, IBM Plex Mono).
- Gradients: `src/components/ui/Gradient` (react-native-svg). Glass: `@react-native-community/blur`.
- Icons: `lucide-react-native`.
- Bundle ID during migration: `com.raku.s0995.bidmanager-mobile.eh` (switch to production ID at cutover, Phase 2H).
- From MacinCloud, only push changes from `Mobile App RN` (root CLAUDE.md) unless that rule is extended to this folder.
